instruction: GUI-only requirement: Complete the task entirely in the KiCad graphical user interface (Project Manager, Schematic Editor, and PCB Editor). Do not open Command Prompt, PowerShell, Terminal, or any shell; do not run kicad-cli, pcbnew in batch mode, Python, or other helper scripts/code that directly generates or edits the deliverable files. Use only KiCad native GUI tools, menus, dialogs, and built-in save/export commands. Mechanical Connector Alignment to Board Edge The file design.kicad_pcb is a 22.86 x 50.80mm Adafruit Feather form-factor board. The USB-C receptacle (J1) is currently placed in the board interior at the wrong position and orientation. It needs to be aligned to the board edge per the Feather specification. Translate and rotate J1 to its correct position and write the result as design.kicad_pcb. Requirements: 1. J1 centre must be at exactly (22.86, 50.80) mm, within +/-0.1 mm. 2. J1 must be rotated so its mating face points outward toward the +Y (top) board edge - this corresponds to a rotation of 180 deg. 3. The rotation must be a multiple of 90 deg. 4. All other components (U1, C1, C2, R1, R2, J2) must remain at their original positions (within +/-0.1 mm). 5. The total component count must remain 7. Write /home/user/Desktop/answer.kicad_pcb.
